SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM MENDIX_APP.AGENTS.BILL_OF_LADING
WHERE STATUS = 'Pending' LIMIT 20

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM MENDIX_APP.AGENTS.BILL_OF_LADING
WHERE STATUS = 'Pending_Review' LIMIT 20

SELECT
    CARRIER_NAME,
    SUM(TOTAL_CHARGES) AS TOTAL_REVENUE
FROM
    MENDIX_APP.AGENTS.BILL_OF_LADING
GROUP BY
    CARRIER_NAME
ORDER BY
    TOTAL_REVENUE DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    B.BL_NUMBER,
    B.CARRIER_NAME,
    B.VESSEL_NAME,
    B.PORT_OF_LOADING_LOCODE,
    B.PORT_OF_DISCHARGE_LOCODE,
    B.ETD,
    B.ETA,
    B.CONTAINER_NUMBER,
    B.COMMODITY_DESCRIPTION,
    B.GROSS_WEIGHT_KGS,
    B.TOTAL_CHARGES,
    B.STATUS,
    B.PAYMENT_STATUS,
    B.SHIPPER_NAME,
    B.CONSIGNEE_NAME,
    B.CREATED_AT,
    S.SAP_DOCUMENT_NUMBER,
    S.COMPANY_CODE,
    S.FISCAL_YEAR,
    S.POSTING_DATE,
    S.DOCUMENT_TYPE,
    S.REFERENCE,
    S.CURRENCY_CODE,
    S.TOTAL_AMOUNT,
    S.CREATED_AT AS SAP_CREATED_AT
FROM
    MENDIX_APP.AGENTS.BILL_OF_LADING B
JOIN
    MENDIX_APP.AGENTS.SAP_FI_DOCUMENT S
ON
    B.BL_ID = S.BL_ID
WHERE
    B.STATUS = 'SAP_POSTED'
ORDER BY
    S.CREATED_AT DESC
LIMIT 20
